feedback: Correct the applicability structure: nltl:bulbousBowPresent is currently mandatory for every ship, including non-IA-Super ships outside this requirement. Keep the ice-class anchor requirement, then use explicit branches so a non-IA-Super ship passes without bulb data, while an IA-Super ship must have exactly one xsd:boolean bulbousBowPresent value; IA Super with false passes as not applicable, and IA Super with true must conform to TRF026CalculationShape. Do not merely remove the global bulb constraint from the existing sh:not conjunction, because an IA-Super ship with missing bulb data would then pass accidentally.
